value: The ground loop detects its own code drift (staleness.diagnostics already does this) and RESPONDS by exiting cleanly, so the launcher respawns a fresh process. Two command flags in instance-space control the behavior: COMMAND_EXIT.flag (clean shutdown on any beat) and COMMAND_DO_NOT_RESTART.flag (suppress the drift-triggered exit during development). The flags architecture: a permanent menu in <instance>/flags/ (ls to see what is available) and active signals as zero-byte COPIES in <instance>/ground_loop/ (the signal folder, same shape every device has). Touch to signal, rm to clear. The menu never empties because the signal is a copy, not a move.
